purpose: Freeze a source-consistent finite-volume domain contract in which the inlet/upstream region is air-only, one interior cell receives the prescribed fuel source exactly once, and the verified teacher algebraic composition closure begins at that injector cell and continues downstream.
implemented: uniform cell-centre grid and interior injector-cell contract
at least one air-only upstream cell
upstream phi=eta=0 composition on the same teacher species basis
localized Delta(mdot_f)/Delta x source at exactly one cell
injector-only axial-velocity and total-enthalpy source profiles
scientific_boundaries: The composition field is an algebraic thermodynamic closure and is not a second conservative mass source.
An injector at the first physical cell is rejected so the current mapping always contains an air-only upstream/inlet region.
The mapping remains H2/C2H4 and lean-branch only; C10H22 thermochemistry is still source-gated.
No species transport PDE, finite-rate chemistry, or independent chemical Qdot source is introduced.
Final teacher inlet/outlet boundary semantics and a source-enabled SSP-RK3 solver remain separate gates.
next_step: Add a narrow source-enabled variable-composition quasi-1D RHS/SSP-RK3 compatibility solver that recomputes Eq.11.38 state-dependent friction at every RK stage while keeping the frozen single-injector mapping fixed; retain the current air-only inlet mapping and do not yet claim final teacher boundary semantics.
